services.desc: 1000 Islands Helicopter Tours offer the most spectacular views of the 1000 Islands Region with five unique tours. The magnificent sights are a perfect photographic opportunity, so cameras are a must for each flight! See the unspoiled beauty and splendor of the St. Lawrence, Gananoque and the Ivy Lea Bridge.
